validation.validation_scope: Same-run active-learning Agent labels; not a representative population accuracy estimate.

至少原神给这种机制安排了合理原因，也给了对应的克制手段。但饕餮呢？不就是饥饿吗，敌人为什么、又怎么能因为饿而复活？换成繁育至少还讲得通。
我真的因为这个破效果没法给K2打出三星。仿佛他们老给银狼安排群攻Boss，还没让她够难受似的。
我可太喜欢游戏直接禁止你玩某些体系了：我想玩击破，结果敌人不能被击破，受到的击破伤害还降低；我想玩Archer，敌人又直接少吃60%伤害，不过场上有忆灵就能减轻这效果。这个游戏到底变成什么了？！
血量膨胀和不断变化的强势体系让我不玩了。其实我很不情愿，因为我喜欢剧情，但同时顾着三个米哈游游戏太累了，钱包也在慢慢见底。💀
这模式已经够难了，就让我这个免费玩家安安稳稳拿一星吧。😭
就是这个改动让我现在讨厌游戏了。以前也有强度膨胀，但现在它正以最糟的方式影响几乎所有东西。

The first thing I need you guys to understand is this:   Aha is Nihilux, but Nihilux is not Aha.    WALK WITH ME. The contradiction disappears once we understand that Aha exists on a completely different plane of reality from Nihilux. We keep trying to fit the entirety of Aha inside Nihilux, when Nihilux is only Aha's greatest manifestation within that particular reality. Think of it like this: we, as the players of Honkai: Star Rail, WE are Aha.** We exist outside the game's reality, and we have the power to choose which characters we obtain, which characters we play, and how much we invest into them. We can also play Wuthering Waves or Genshin Impact without somehow becoming those games. Now imagine that Honkai: Star Rail becomes my favourite game. I spend the most time on it, the most money on it, and get the greatest amount of enjoyment from it. That game would become my greatest source of elation, but it would never become me. Nihilux works in exactly the same way for Aha. Nihilux is essentially Aha's **C6 R5 favourite character** — the one Aha has invested the most into, the one that gives them the greatest elation, and therefore the one they choose to manifest through most often. This becomes even clearer when Aha finally reveals themselves to be Nihilux. Rather than abandoning Nihilux and taking on some completely separate identity, Aha essentially **upgrades Nihilux's skin**: they become the Queen of Hearts, revealing something closer to their true nature while deliberately continuing to speak through Nihilux's voice. Why? Because Aha likes the Nihilux form. Aha can speak through many voices, but when given the opportunity to reveal themselves, they choose to continue using the voice and identity of their favourite mask. It is exactly like me taking a character I love, investing everything into them, C6 R5-ing them, buying their new skin, and then continuing to play them even though **I am still the player behind the character**. The character hasn't become me; I simply enjoy experiencing the game through that character. The moment where we look deeply into Nihilux's eyes and witness the **conjuring of Aha** is therefore important because we aren't discovering that Nihilux was secretly the entirety of Aha. Instead, we are seeing the player behind the character. We are momentarily looking past the mask and seeing the being that exists beyond it. Aha can speak in countless voices because Aha isn't restricted to any one manifestation, but Nihilux remains the preferred voice because Nihilux is Aha's favourite. Even Aha acting while Nihilux is inside the Party Car follows the same principle. If I can have HSR running on one device while simultaneously playing Wuthering Waves or Genshin on another, the characters and worlds don't cease to exist simply because I am interacting with something else. **My attention can move between different realities because I exist outside all of them.** In the same way, Aha can act independently while Nihilux remains within her own reality. Nihilux is therefore not the boundary of Aha; she is the mask Aha loves most. **Aha is the player. Nihilux is the favourite character. The Queen of Hearts is the upgraded skin.
